class.name: LocalizationServer
class.brief_description: Base class of the localization servers: catalog layers, the locale and its fallback chain.
class.description:
[LocalizationServer] is the abstract base of [TextLocalizationServer] (texts). It holds [LocalizationCatalog]s as layers with a priority, one key index over all layers and the data of the active locale chain. [b]Locale:[/b] the locale is stored in [TranslationServer], so controls, the editor and resource remaps follow it too. [method set_locale], [method get_locale] and [method get_fallback_locale] are static and forward to it. A call to [method TranslationServer.set_locale] reaches the servers as well, before the scene tree re-translates its nodes. [b]Locale chain:[/b] a text is looked up for the locale, then for its parent locales and then for the fallback locale, for example [code]de_DE[/code] → [code]de[/code] → [code]en[/code] (see [method get_locale_chain]). [b]Priority:[/b] the chain comes first (a text for [code]de_DE[/code] beats a text for [code]de[/code]), then the layers: the catalog with the higher priority wins; with equal priority, the catalog added later wins. A typical order is game (0) < DLC (50) < mods (100). [b]On-demand locales:[/b] catalogs loaded from [code].lcat[/code] files read a locale only when it is needed. The server reads the locales of the active chain and unloads the other locales of file-backed catalogs on a locale change. [b]Project settings:[/b] the catalogs of [member ProjectSettings.internationalization/localization/catalogs] and [member ProjectSettings.internationalization/localization/external_catalogs] are loaded at startup (see [method load_project_catalogs]). [b]Threads:[/b] reading is lock-free. Changes of catalogs and the locale are applied on the main thread; calls from other threads are deferred. Signals are emitted on the main thread. [codeblocks] [gdscript] LocalizationServer.set_locale("de_DE") print(LocalizationServer.get_locale_chain("de_DE")) # ["de_DE", "de", "en"]
var mod_texts = load("user://mods/knights/translations/texts.lcat") TextLocalizationServer.add_catalog(mod_texts, 100) [/gdscript] [csharp] LocalizationServer.SetLocale("de_DE"); GD.Print(LocalizationServer.GetLocaleChain("de_DE")); // ["de_DE", "de", "en"]
var modTexts = GD.Load<TextLocalizationCatalog>("user://mods/knights/translations/texts.lcat"); TextLocalizationServer.AddCatalog(modTexts, 100); [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

method.name: add_catalog
method.description: Adds [param catalog] as a layer with [param priority]. A catalog that was already added moves to the new priority. The catalog must be of the class this server takes ([TextLocalizationCatalog] for [TextLocalizationServer]). Changes of the catalog's content are picked up on the next idle frame. Emits [signal catalogs_changed].

method.name: add_catalog_list
method.description: Loads and adds the catalogs of all entries of [param list], each with the priority of its entry, and returns the number of catalogs added. Files of another catalog class are skipped, so one list may name text and resource catalogs. [code].lcat[/code], [code].tres[/code] and [code].res[/code] files are loaded with [ResourceLoader]; text formats (JSON, CSV, XML, INI, TOML, YAML) are read with [method LocalizationCatalog.load_from_file] as this server's catalog class. Main thread only.

method.name: clear_catalogs
method.description: Removes all catalogs. Key ids returned by [method TextLocalizationServer.get_key_id] stay valid. Emits [signal catalogs_changed].

method.name: get_available_locales
method.description: Returns the locales of all catalogs, each once, for example to fill a language menu.

method.name: get_catalogs
method.description: Returns the catalogs, the lowest priority first.

method.name: get_fallback_locale
method.description: Returns the fallback locale of [TranslationServer] ([member ProjectSettings.internationalization/locale/fallback]), the last part of every locale chain.

method.name: get_key_count
method.description: Returns the number of keys (rows) the server knows. Rows are never removed while the server runs, so this also counts keys of removed catalogs.

method.name: get_locale
method.description: Returns the active locale, as [method TranslationServer.get_locale].

method.name: get_locale_chain
method.description: Returns the locales a text is looked up in, in order: the standardized [param locale], its parent locales and then the fallback locale and its parents, each once. For example [code]"de_DE"[/code] gives [code]["de_DE", "de", "en"][/code] with the fallback locale [code]en[/code].

method.name: load_project_catalogs
method.description: Adds the catalogs of [member ProjectSettings.internationalization/localization/catalogs] with priority 0 and those of [member ProjectSettings.internationalization/localization/external_catalogs] with [member ProjectSettings.internationalization/localization/external_catalogs_priority], as with [method add_catalog_list], and returns the number of catalogs added. The engine calls it at startup; call it again after mods were installed.

method.name: remove_catalog
method.description: Removes [param catalog]. Its keys keep their ids but have no text from it anymore. Emits [signal catalogs_changed].

method.name: set_locale
method.description: Sets the active locale with [method TranslationServer.set_locale]. Every localization server builds the data of the new locale chain and emits [signal locale_changed]; then the nodes re-translate.

signal.name: catalogs_changed
signal.description: Emitted after catalogs were added or removed, or after the content of a catalog changed, once the server's data was rebuilt.

signal.name: locale_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the active locale changed and the data of the new chain is ready, before the nodes re-translate.

signal.name: locale_loaded
signal.description: Emitted when the texts of [param locale] became available: when it joins the active locale chain and a catalog has it.
